title: Withhold dependent claims until the prerequisite has delivery evidence
description:
Objective: stop dependent work building on a promise the recorded delivery does not support. Today dependsOn gating keys purely on the prerequisite's status reaching DONE or ARCHIVED, so a task that reached DONE without a landed commit still releases everything waiting on it.

Deliverable: the dependency satisfaction check in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/dependencyUnblock.ts and the claim gating in tools/claimNextTask.ts additionally require that a DONE prerequisite satisfies the project's delivery policy. A prerequisite that is DONE but lacks the required evidence keeps its dependents withheld, and the claim result explains exactly which prerequisite and which evidence is missing.

Not in scope: changing what dependsOn means for planning, which still proceeds, or the auto-unblock of blockedOnTaskIds targets beyond applying the same evidence rule. Under the default behaviour-preserving delivery policy nothing changes, so existing projects see no difference.

Unskips the acceptance case "a failed required gate cannot release dependents".

Verification: npx vitest run src/state/dependencyUnblock.test.ts src/delivery/acceptance.test.ts from packages/moe-daemon.
definitionOfDone: A DONE prerequisite lacking the evidence its delivery policy requires keeps its dependents unclaimable
The refusal names the prerequisite task and the specific missing evidence
Planning on a dependent task still proceeds, matching the existing rule that dependsOn gates WORKING-status claims only
The blockedOnTaskIds auto-unblock applies the same evidence rule rather than releasing on status alone
Under the default delivery policy behaviour is unchanged and the existing dependency tests stay green unmodified
The acceptance case for a failed required gate not releasing dependents is unskipped and passes unchanged
npx vitest run src/state/dependencyUnblock.test.ts src/delivery/acceptance.test.ts passes and npm test in packages/moe-daemon stays green
taskRails: dependsOn still gates WORKING-status claims only; planning must keep proceeding.
Missing or deleted prerequisite ids keep counting as satisfied, as they do today.
